name: Applebee's Plain Grilled Chicken Breast (No Seasoning, Plain Steamed Broccoli)
whyItWorks: Skinless chicken breast grilled dry without Applebee's garlic-pepper seasoning blend. Paired with plain steamed broccoli (florets only) or plain baked potato for a safe sit-down dinner.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order: 'Grilled chicken breast completely plain—NO seasoning, NO butter, grilled dry.' Pair with plain steamed broccoli or baked potato.
